items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I’m going to take a — Bonnie, is there something I should have asked her? BT: I think you’ve just done a marvelous job.

ctx.x: Because my nephew, who plays bass on my family album, he has moved to Sweden now. So if I want to see him I’ve got to go to Sweden.

I’m going to take a — Bonnie, is there something I should have asked her? BT: I think you’ve just done a marvelous job. I’m sitting here thinking I am so grateful. This interview, it’s so important. And the questions are so — I imaging they’re well thought out but they come across as being so spontaneous. It’s marvelous. I’m just having a ball.
I’m just really honored. I mean I know who the other people are in this Archive and I’m going wow, Milt Hinton. You know?
